seasons.name: Stagione 2
seasons.plot: In season 2, Evan still refuses to stay quiet when controversy arises at Morrison-Hensley High. The gang finds themselves in the crosshairs of issues including climate change, Covid, military recruitment and student phone usage. Evan also struggles to keep his relationship with Malcolm separate from his work life. Even though Malcolm no longer works at Morrison-Hensley, Evan’s excessive righteousness at school takes an increasing toll on his romantic life.

tagline.value: Learning from A to Gen Z.

translations.overview: Un insegnante di scuola superiore di Austin cerca di bilanciare le richieste contrastanti degli studenti e dei loro genitori in un mondo in cui le regole sembrano cambiare ogni giorno.
A high school teacher in Austin tries to balance the competing demands of the students and their parents in a world where the rules seem to change every day.
translations.tagline: Learning from A to Gen Z.
